Italian Sausage Meal
By: Anonymous
Published: Monday, November 30, 2009 - 11:34pm

Ingredients




6 link Italian sausages, cut in 2" pieces (3 hot, 3 sweet)
3 russet or red potatoes, cut in fourths
1 lrg onion (white)
1 red pepper*
1 yellow pepper*
2 clv garlic, unpeeled
2 zucchini

Preparation

1 *Can use 1 green. Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Bake sausage with quartered potatoes for 1/2 hour in 9"x13" pan or casserole. Drain fat. Add onions, peppers, garlic and zucchini. Continue cooking 1/2 hour or until potatoes are done. Serve with bread. Wonderful one dish meal.
